IC2: Subjects who have human Immunodeficiency virus (HIV) [OR], hepatitis B virus (HBV) [OR], and hepatitis C virus (HCV)
IC3: Subjects who need to take the medicine which is prohibited during this study
IC5: Subjects who can not stop [AND] treatment with topical steroids [OR] (group 1~5), oral antibiotics [OR], whole body photochemotherapy [OR], immunosuppressive drug within 4 weeks before the treatment visit
IC6: Pregnant, breast-feeding women [OR] or women [OR] who plan to become [AND] pregnant during this study (Females [AND] of childbearing potential [AND] must have a negative urine pregnancy test)
IC7: Subjects who currently participate in other clinical trial or participated in other clinical trial within 30 days
IC8: Subjects who had a serious adverse events during stem cell therapy
IC9: Subjects who had a hypersensitivity to antibiotics [OR] or antimycotics
IC10: Subjects who creatinine value is more than two times of the upper limit of the normal range at screening test
IC11: Subjects who aspartate transaminase/alkaline transaminase (AST/ALT) value is more than three times of the upper limit of the normal range at screening test
IC12: Subjects who have any other condition which the investigator judges would make patients unsuitable for study participation
